vulnerability_cn: 即时储备定价与推荐奖励组合导致价格操纵
vulnerability_en: Reserve-derived livePrice manipulation through flash-funded referral rewards
detail_cn: DLMC 的 buy 将临时投入的 USDT 立即记为投资额，并把大部分新铸 DLMC 留在合约；推荐人按更新前价格收到可立即出售的奖励。_updatePrice 使用合约 USDT 储备，且在条件成立时扣除合约自持 DLMC，导致两次买入后价格大幅提高。攻击者以42万USDT建立168万USDT卖出额度，再由下级投入100万USDT获得推荐奖励，卖出其中65908.6853 DLMC取得1646119.1189 USDT，偿还闪电资金后收款地址净入222560.2217 USDT。独立成功回执与exact-match源码支持金额及可达路径，未取得完整trace；源表日期6月25日、损失222600美元保持不变，链上交易在6月24日，受害合约本笔USDT净流出226119.1189，与获利分开。
detail_en: buy immediately credits temporary USDT as investment while minting most DLMC to the contract; the referrer receives immediately sellable rewards at the pre-update price. _updatePrice trusts current USDT reserves and conditionally excludes contract-held DLMC from supply. A first 420000 USDT buy established a 1680000 USDT sell cap; a downstream 1000000 USDT buy rewarded the attacker and inflated livePrice. Selling 65908.6853 DLMC redeemed 1646119.1189 USDT; after flash repayment the recipient received 222560.2217 USDT. Independently fetched receipt and exact-match source support amounts and reachable mechanism; no complete trace was available. Preserve sheet date June 25 and USD 222600; transaction date is June 24 and victim net token outflow was 226119.1189 USDT, a different scope.
source_verification: Sourcify creation/runtime exact_match; 14 original Solidity sources and 10-source audit slice locally compile with solc 0.8.31. All 59 retained function bodies checked. Transaction and successful receipt independently fetched from BNB Chain RPC; event ordering, amounts and redemption formula verified. Historical eth_call and debug_traceTransaction returned missing trie node. No complete trace, fork replay or independent historical runtime comparison.
